agents.name: retriever
agents.instruction: Read the 10 numbered Wikipedia paragraphs and the question. Identify which paragraphs contain information needed to answer the question, ignoring distractors. Output the numbers of the relevant paragraphs as a comma‑separated list.

agents.name: reasoner
agents.instruction: Using only the paragraphs whose numbers appear in {relevant_paragraphs?} from the original input (which includes the 10 paragraphs and the question in {user_query?}), perform the required multi‑hop reasoning and output a short factual answer—just the answer itself, no explanation.
